tools.name: resolve_party
tools.title: Resolve party
tools.description: Resolve an external identity (provider + externalId on a channel) into a friend record, creating one on first contact. Returns { friend, channel, created }.

provider.description: identity provider, e.g. aad, local, teams-conversation, imessage-handle, email-address, a2a-agent

externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

displayName.description: display name for the party (use 'Unknown' if not known)

channel.description: the channel/sense the session belongs to, e.g. cli, teams, mcp

tools.name: describe_trust
tools.title: Describe trust
tools.description: Explain the trust context for a friend: level, basis (direct/shared_group/unknown), what it permits and constrains.

isGroupChat.description: set to 'true' when the conversation is a group chat

tools.name: assess_standing
tools.title: Assess standing
tools.description: Assess a peer's earned standing from your FIRST-PARTY outcomes with them: a tier (proven/reliable/mixed/untested/troubled), the basis count, and the tally. Advisory only: it changes no trust and is not shared. Returns a Standing, or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the friend is missing.

tools.name: explain_standing
tools.title: Explain standing
tools.description: Explain a peer's earned standing in words: the tier with a human summary, why, and advisory notes that frame it as input to a MANUAL trust decision (not an instruction to change trust). Returns a StandingExplanation, or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the friend is missing.

tools.name: get_friend
tools.title: Get friend
tools.description: Fetch a single friend record by uuid or by name.

tools.name: list_friends
tools.title: List friends
tools.description: List friend records, optionally filtered by trust level and kind, optionally limited.

limit.description: max number of records to return

tools.name: save_note
tools.title: Save note
tools.description: Save a friend's name, a tool preference, or a general note. Use override='true' to overwrite an existing value.

override.description: set to 'true' to overwrite an existing value

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.title: Record interaction
tools.description: Record a turn with a friend: accumulate token usage and/or append a shared-mission outcome (bumping familiarity).

usage.description: token usage; only output_tokens is counted

tools.name: upsert_group
tools.title: Upsert group
tools.description: Upsert shared-group participant context: link each participant to the group, promoting strangers to acquaintances.

tools.name: set_trust
tools.title: Set trust
tools.description: Set a friend's trust level (also mirrors it onto the record's role).

tools.name: link_identity
tools.title: Link identity
tools.description: Link an external identity to a friend, merging any orphan record that already holds it (cross-channel unification): the orphan's notes and other ids move onto the friend and the orphan record is deleted. An id the friend already holds answers ok with status noop, or retry_unsupported when the store can't list records to finish an interrupted merge.

externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

tools.name: unlink_identity
tools.title: Unlink identity
tools.description: Remove an external identity from a friend.

provider.description: identity provider, e.g. aad, local, teams-conversation, imessage-handle, email-address, a2a-agent

externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

tools.name: onboard_agent
tools.title: Onboard agent
tools.description: Upsert an agent-peer friend record from already-resolved coordinates (no HTTP card fetch).

mailbox.description: optional A2A git-mailbox coords { repo, selfOutboxAgentId }

tools.name: connect_to
tools.title: Connect to
tools.description: Management-sense control plane (brick 8): the owner links one of their OWN agents into this agent's fleet — introduce a peer by agentId/did/name at a trust level (default family for own-fleet). Authority-gated: commits inline ONLY from a local (owner-only stdio) or roster-verified same-account closed sense; from an open sense it downgrades to a confirm-prompt instead; a bare name with no resolvable handle/DID, no record hit, or more than one agent of that name returns needs_handle_or_introduction (it links only a target it can find). Writes one control-plane audit record (action:'connect') through the wired sink. Returns { ok:true, status:'connected', record } or { ok:false, status:'downgraded'|'needs_handle_or_introduction', downgrade? }.

agentId.description: the peer agent's join-key agentId (an owner-supplied handle)

did.description: the peer's DID (an alternative handle; must resolve to an existing record)

name.description: the peer's colloquial name (resolves ONLY by matching an existing record — never fabricated)

trustLevel.description: the trust to link at (default family for own-fleet linked agents)

proof.description: optional opaque proof slot (reserved; the TOFU path ignores it)

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Resolve who the machine owner is and which friend record represents the self.

tools.name: channel_caps
tools.title: Channel capabilities
tools.description: Return the capabilities of a channel (integrations, markdown, streaming, rich cards, max length).

tools.name: resolve_room
tools.title: Resolve room
tools.description: Resolve a room (a group's external id) into its members, each with their trust context and how they're known (direct/group_only). Pure read.

channel.description: channel lens for the trust explanation (default mcp)

tools.name: share_profile
tools.title: Share profile
tools.description: Producer: prepare a consent-gated, scope-filtered, provenance-preserving profile-share envelope for another agent (names the party by join key, not the local uuid). Self identity comes from whoami. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status }.

friendId.description: the local friend to share (uuid or name)

scope.description: what to share: identity scopes carry only the join key; notes:* / outcomes require an explicit grant under the default tiered policy

proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Prepare this scope of what you know about this person to send to that agent?

tools.name: import_profile
tools.title: Import profile
tools.description: Consumer (non-clobbering merge): import a profile-share envelope. Resolves the party by join key; lands notes in importedNotes and an outcomes share's outcomes in importedOutcomes, both under the source agent, WITHOUT touching first-party notes or outcomes; source trust caps acceptance; the party's trust stays as it was. Returns { ok, status, record, importedOutcomes }.

fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

tools.name: grant_share
tools.title: Grant share
tools.description: Mint an explicit, revocable consent grant: an agent may receive a scope of a subject (a friend's profile, keyed by friend uuid; or a mission, keyed by its missionKey). The consent half of the moat.

subjectKey.description: whose data may be shared — a local friend uuid for a profile, or a missionKey for a mission (the legacy arg name subjectFriendId is still accepted)

recipientAgentId.description: the agent that may receive it (join-key agentId)

expiresAt.description: optional ISO expiry; absent ⇒ never expires

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Let that agent receive this scope from now on, until the grant expires or is revoked?

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.title: Revoke share
tools.description: Revoke a consent grant by id (tombstones it; the audit trail survives). The right-to-be-forgotten lever. Revoking a grant that is already revoked answers ok with status noop.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.title: List shares
tools.description: List consent grants with their effective state, optionally filtered by subject / recipient / effectiveness. The audit + revoke surface.

subjectKey.description: filter to one subject — a friend uuid or a missionKey (the legacy arg name subjectFriendId is still accepted)

effectiveOnly.description: set to 'true' to return only grants that currently consent

tools.name: record_mission
tools.title: Record mission
tools.description: Upsert a shared mission (brick 3) by its cross-agent missionKey: create one when the key is unknown, else merge into the existing record. Appends first-party learnings / participants / outcomes and sets status. The mission analogue of record_interaction's outcome writer. Returns the saved mission record.

missionKey.description: the cross-agent join key for the mission (a ticket id / repo+PR / slugged name)

title.description: human title; used only when CREATING (ignored on upsert)

participants.description: agent attributions [{ agentId?, agentName? }], each naming at least one, merged deduped by agentId

learnings.description: first-party learnings [{ key, value, shareable? }] appended to the mission

outcomes.description: first-party outcomes [{ missionId, result, note? }] appended to the mission

tools.name: get_mission
tools.title: Get mission
tools.description: Fetch a single mission record by its local uuid id.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.title: List missions
tools.description: List mission records, optionally limited.

limit.description: max number of records to return

tools.name: share_mission
tools.title: Share mission
tools.description: Producer: prepare a consent-gated, scope-filtered, provenance-preserving mission-share envelope for another agent (names the mission by its missionKey, not the local uuid). Self identity comes from whoami. 'mission' carries the shareable learnings; 'outcomes' carries the mission's outcomes. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status }.

missionId.description: the local mission to share (its local uuid id)

scope.description: what to share: 'mission' (title/status + shareable learnings) or 'outcomes' (the result rows); both require an explicit grant under the tiered policy

proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Prepare this scope of the mission to send to that agent?

tools.name: import_mission
tools.title: Import mission
tools.description: Consumer (non-clobbering merge): import a mission-share envelope. Resolves the mission by missionKey; lands learnings in the imported namespace WITHOUT touching first-party learnings; append-merges + dedupes outcomes; source trust caps acceptance; leaves status/participants as they were. Returns { ok, status, record }.

fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

tools.name: coordinate
tools.title: Coordinate
tools.description: Producer (brick 5): prepare a coordination message that negotiates WHO does a mission — one of request/offer/accept/decline/handoff, named by the mission's missionKey (not the local uuid). Consent-gated via the identity-tier 'coordinate' scope (trust ≥ friend suffices). 'accept' claims the assignment for self; 'handoff' (only by the agent holding the assignment) proposes a new assignee whose own accept confirms it (non-transitive). Self identity comes from whoami. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status: not_found|no_consent|not_assignee }.

missionId.description: the local mission to coordinate (its local uuid id)

intent.description: the coordination verb: request (will you take this?) / offer (I'll take this) / accept (yes, I'm on it — sets assignee=self) / decline (no) / handoff (it's yours now — you must hold the assignment; proposes a new assignee)

note.description: optional free text carried on the message + logged

proposedAssignee.description: the proposed new assignee { agentId?, agentName? } — meaningful ONLY on intent=handoff

task.description: optional delegation task-spec { summary, details?, inputs? } — meaningful ONLY on intent=request (gap-2); the producer mints a requestId, stamps it on the envelope, and records the delegation first-party for the result-return to correlate against

proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Prepare this coordination message about the mission for that agent?

tools.name: import_coordination
tools.title: Import coordination
tools.description: Consumer (brick 5, non-clobbering merge): import a coordination message. Resolves the mission by missionKey; appends the intent to coordination.log stamped origin:imported WITHOUT touching first-party learnings/notes/status; only an 'accept' sets the assignee (last-writer-wins by issuedAt); a 'handoff' doesn't set the assignee on its own (only an accept does); status/trust/standing stay as they were; source trust caps acceptance; a friend/family peer may seed an unknown mission. Returns { ok, status: logged|assigned|seeded, record } or { ok:false, status }.

fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

tools.name: get_coordination
tools.title: Get coordination
tools.description: Read lens (brick 5): return a mission's coordination state — its current assignee (who holds it; absent ⇒ unclaimed) + the append-only log of every request/offer/accept/decline/handoff that flowed. Returns { assignee, assignedAt?, log } (the empty default { assignee: undefined, log: [] } when it has had no coordination), or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the mission is missing.

tools.name: send_result
tools.title: Send result
tools.description: Producer (gap-2 — the result-return): B returns its DELIVERABLE for a delegation, attributed to B (from whoami) + correlated to A's task-spec by requestId, named by the mission's missionKey (not the local uuid). Consent-gated via the identity-tier 'coordinate' scope (a result is B answering A's own delegation — trust ≥ friend suffices; NO new scope). Records the result first-party on B's own mission. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status: not_found|no_consent }.

missionId.description: the local mission B is returning a result for (its local uuid id)

toAgentId.description: the recipient agent's join-key agentId — A, the delegator

requestId.description: the delegation correlation key (the task-spec's requestId)

proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Record this result on the mission and prepare it for the agent that asked?

tools.name: import_result
tools.title: Import result
tools.description: Consumer (gap-2, non-clobbering merge): A imports B's result-return. Resolves the mission by missionKey; lands B's deliverable QUARANTINED + attributed under importedResults WITHOUT touching first-party; source trust caps acceptance (checked before correlation); a result whose requestId matches no prior first-party delegation is REJECTED (no_delegation — A only accepts results for work it delegated); an unknown mission is no_mission (only record_mission creates a mission); status and participants stay as A recorded them. Returns { ok, status, record } or { ok:false, status: untrusted_source|no_mission|no_delegation|assignee_mismatch|invalid }. A second result for a request already imported from that agent answers ok with status noop and keeps the first.

fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId) — B

trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap
